about_short_description.short_description: Payroll, HR and benefits Saas solution designed for small to medium-sized companies in Latin America.

product.name: Payroll Management
product.description: A cloud-based system that automates payroll calculations, tax declarations, and salary dispersions for companies.

product.name: Attendance Module
product.description: A system to track, edit, and manage employee attendance, shifts, and overtime with real-time monitoring.

product.name: Employee Management Module
product.description: A platform to centralize employee data, documents, and track HR events with self-service capabilities.

product.name: Incidence Management
product.description: A tool to manage employee absences, vacations, and other HR incidents with automatic payroll integration.

product.name: Benefits Administration
product.description: A service to add employee benefits such as insurance, savings programs, and flexible vouchers integrated with payroll.

product.name: Payroll Outsourcing Service (Maquila de Nómina)
product.description: A payroll outsourcing service where Runa partners with accountants to manage payroll processing and tax declarations.
